title: Calcined AlPO$_{4}$-34 Structure
comments:
This is yet another of the many possible crystal structures in the \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{silica/aluminum phosphate system}. (Szostak, 1989) relates it to \href{current_web_home_dir/A5B21C24D12_hR62_166_a2c_ehi_fg2h_i-001}{chabazite}. Like all such crystals, it consists of connected AlO$_{4}$ and PO$_{4}$ tetrahedra. 
 This sample was calcined, {\em e.g.} heated below the melting temperature to remove any organic and water molecules. The rehydrated samples have $P1$ symmetry, and neither (Tuel, 2000) nor (Poulet, 2002) give the positions of the hydrogen atoms, so we pass on showing that structure for now.
